in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root word ‘anu’ meaning towards and ‘miya’ meaning mine, dear, loved one. It is a term of endearment, often used to express deep love and affection.

in_marathi.name: Anmiya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anmiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anmiya is a Sanskrit name for a female that represents the embodiment of love and desire. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu-miya', which means 'desirable'. In Hindu mythology, Anmiya is considered to be the goddess of love and desire. She is also known as 'Manmatha', the god of love.
